test.fill_query: INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_u64 SELECT case_id, {matrix_length}, arrayMap(x -> multiIf( case_id = 1 AND x = 0, toUInt64('18446744073709551615'), case_id = 2 AND x = intDiv({matrix_length}, 2), toUInt64('18446744073709551615'), case_id = 3 AND x = {matrix_length} - 1, toUInt64('18446744073709551615'), case_id = 5 AND x = 0, toUInt64(0), case_id = 6 AND x = intDiv({matrix_length}, 2), toUInt64(0), case_id = 7 AND x = {matrix_length} - 1, toUInt64(0), case_id > 4, toUInt64(x + 1), toUInt64(x)), range({matrix_length})) FROM numbers(greatest(1, intDiv(12000, {matrix_length}))) ARRAY JOIN [1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7] AS case_id

INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_u8 SELECT case_id, {narrow_length}, arrayMap(x -> multiIf( case_id = 1 AND x = 0, toUInt8(255), case_id = 2 AND x = intDiv({narrow_length}, 2), toUInt8(255), case_id = 3 AND x = {narrow_length} - 1, toUInt8(255), case_id = 5 AND x = 0, toUInt8(0), case_id = 6 AND x = intDiv({narrow_length}, 2), toUInt8(0), case_id = 7 AND x = {narrow_length} - 1, toUInt8(0), case_id > 4, toUInt8(x % 100 + 1), toUInt8(x % 100)), range({narrow_length})) FROM numbers(greatest(1, intDiv(12000, {narrow_length}))) ARRAY JOIN [1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7] AS case_id

INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_u16 SELECT case_id, {small_width_length}, arrayMap(x -> multiIf( case_id = 1 AND x = 0, toUInt16(65535), case_id = 2 AND x = intDiv({small_width_length}, 2), toUInt16(65535), case_id = 3 AND x = {small_width_length} - 1, toUInt16(65535), case_id = 5 AND x = 0, toUInt16(0), case_id = 6 AND x = intDiv({small_width_length}, 2), toUInt16(0), case_id = 7 AND x = {small_width_length} - 1, toUInt16(0), case_id > 4, toUInt16(x + 1), toUInt16(x)), range({small_width_length})) FROM numbers(greatest(1, intDiv(12000, {small_width_length}))) ARRAY JOIN [1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7] AS case_id

INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_u32 SELECT case_id, {small_width_length}, arrayMap(x -> multiIf( case_id = 1 AND x = 0, toUInt32(4294967295), case_id = 2 AND x = intDiv({small_width_length}, 2), toUInt32(4294967295), case_id = 3 AND x = {small_width_length} - 1, toUInt32(4294967295), case_id = 5 AND x = 0, toUInt32(0), case_id = 6 AND x = intDiv({small_width_length}, 2), toUInt32(0), case_id = 7 AND x = {small_width_length} - 1, toUInt32(0), case_id > 4, toUInt32(x + 1), toUInt32(x)), range({small_width_length})) FROM numbers(greatest(1, intDiv(12000, {small_width_length}))) ARRAY JOIN [1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7] AS case_id

INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_i64 SELECT case_id, {matrix_length}, arrayMap(x -> multiIf( case_id = 1 AND x = 0, toInt64(1000000000000), case_id = 2 AND x = intDiv({matrix_length}, 2), toInt64(1000000000000), case_id = 3 AND x = {matrix_length} - 1, toInt64(1000000000000), case_id = 5 AND x = 0, toInt64(-1000000000000), case_id = 6 AND x = intDiv({matrix_length}, 2), toInt64(-1000000000000), case_id = 7 AND x = {matrix_length} - 1, toInt64(-1000000000000), case_id > 4, toInt64(x + 1), toInt64(x)), range({matrix_length})) FROM numbers(greatest(1, intDiv(12000, {matrix_length}))) ARRAY JOIN [1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7] AS case_id

INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_float SELECT case_id, {matrix_length}, arrayMap(x -> multiIf( case_id = 1 AND x = 0, toFloat64(1000000000000), case_id = 2 AND x = intDiv({matrix_length}, 2), toFloat64(1000000000000), case_id = 3 AND x = {matrix_length} - 1, toFloat64(1000000000000), case_id = 5 AND x = 0, toFloat64(-1000000000000), case_id = 6 AND x = intDiv({matrix_length}, 2), toFloat64(-1000000000000), case_id = 7 AND x = {matrix_length} - 1, toFloat64(-1000000000000), case_id > 4, toFloat64(x + 1), toFloat64(x)), range({matrix_length})) FROM numbers(greatest(1, intDiv(12000, {matrix_length}))) ARRAY JOIN [1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7] AS case_id
INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_float SELECT 9, 16384, arrayMap(x -> nan, range(16384)) FROM numbers(32)

INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_float SELECT 10, 17408, arrayConcat( arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(x), range(1024)), arrayMap(x -> nan, range(1024)), arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(x), range(15360))) FROM numbers(32)

INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_string SELECT case_id, {edge_length}, arrayMap(x -> multiIf( case_id = 1 AND x = 0, 'zzzzzzzzzz', case_id = 2 AND x = intDiv({edge_length}, 2), 'zzzzzzzzzz', case_id = 3 AND x = {edge_length} - 1, 'zzzzzzzzzz', case_id = 5 AND x = 0, '', case_id = 6 AND x = intDiv({edge_length}, 2), '', case_id = 7 AND x = {edge_length} - 1, '', concat('item-', toString(x))), range({edge_length})) FROM numbers(greatest(1, intDiv(6000, {edge_length}))) ARRAY JOIN [1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7] AS case_id

INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_nullable SELECT case_id, {edge_length}, arrayMap(x -> toNullable(multiIf( case_id = 1 AND x = 0, toInt64(1000000000000), case_id = 2 AND x = intDiv({edge_length}, 2), toInt64(1000000000000), case_id = 3 AND x = {edge_length} - 1, toInt64(1000000000000), case_id = 5 AND x = 0, toInt64(-1000000000000), case_id = 6 AND x = intDiv({edge_length}, 2), toInt64(-1000000000000), case_id = 7 AND x = {edge_length} - 1, toInt64(-1000000000000), case_id > 4, toInt64(x + 1), toInt64(x))), range({edge_length})) FROM numbers(greatest(1, intDiv(6000, {edge_length}))) ARRAY JOIN [1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7] AS case_id
